caption: The drawing depicts a square-shaped pattern located centrally on a light, off-white background. The square itself consists of a grid composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, forming a woven or textile-like texture. The grid is primarily made up of blue, orange-red, and beige lines and rectangles. The blue and orange-red colors alternate and intersect, creating a checkerboard effect, with some sections being solid in color and others interspersed with small, evenly spaced, rectangular gaps, giving a sense of woven threads. The beige background of the grid is visible between the colored lines. In the bottom right area of the drawing, there is a small, handwritten signature or inscription. The rest of the background is unembellished, emphasizing the central square pattern.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
